messages:
lina: Dropping notes from design critique — new "min/max pinch" control + burst scheduler prototype uploaded: https://figma.redwood/minmax-pinch-v1

omar: Saw it. Love the pinch idea for quick min/max adjust. Question: how does pinch interact with the SLO tiles? If you pinch min above current min SLO, do we clamp or show warning?

lina: Proposal: pinch updates min/max immediately; if it violates SLO constraints show a non-blocking inline banner: "SLO constraint breach: may increase cost or latency. Preview changes" with a link to details.

tas: Accessibility: pinch as a gesture isn't keyboard/native. Need keyboard equivalents: plus/minus buttons, and an input with stepper. Also ensure theres an ARIA description: "Use arrow keys to adjust min and max".

maya: UX: added small SLO micro-tiles above each pool card showing current target + health. If pinch pushes min above tile, tile pulses and tooltip explains impact. Microcopy: "Min above SLO: may reduce availability". Thoughts?

kevin: a11y + keyboard: micro-tiles should be focusable, and when they change state we announce: `aria-live="polite"` "Availability risk increased for Pool X". For pinch controls add `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` like "Min: 2 GPUs, Max: 6 GPUs".

a11y-bot: Contrast check: pinch grabber color fails AA on small screens for text-on-color labels. Recommend darker border and 4.5:1 label contrast.

lina: Noted. Also added a "burst scheduler" — small timeline scrubber to set start/end windows (e.g., 10:00-10:15). Scheduler defaults to local timezone and shows est. cost delta. Copy: "Schedule temporary capacity" -> confirm CTA: "Schedule burst".

omar: Scheduler UX Q: if multiple bursts overlap across pools, how do we visualize conflict? I mocked a heatmap overlay on pool affinity showing combined GPU usage. Could show stacked bars per timeslot.

tas: Heatmap idea ok but needs SR-friendly summary. Provide a list view fallback with textual summaries: "10:00-10:15: Pool A +2 GPUs, Pool B +1 GPU (total +3)". Keep that in DOM.

kevin: Reorder + drag in affinity view: announce movement "Pool A moved to affinity group 2". For touch targets ensure 44px min. For pinch control increase hit area to avoid accidental drags.

lina: Copy asks: short label for pinch should be "Min/Max" (2 chars). Tooltip: "Adjust minimum and maximum reserved GPUs". Also microcopy for the clamp banner: "Suggested action: lower min or increase global SLO".

a11y-bot: Provide example SR snippet for scheduler confirm: `aria-live="assertive"` "Burst scheduled for Pool A at 10:00-10:15; estimated cost +0.9%" and ensure dialog uses `role=dialog` with `aria-modal=true`.

maya: Plan: update figma with keyboard steppers, SR snippets in annotations, contrast tweaks, and heatmap textual fallback. Will push v1.2 by EOD. @omar please build heatmap fallback list. @kevin + @tas please run keyboard + SR pass tomorrow.

lina: Thanks everyone — feel free to drop inline comments on the prototype. :sparkles:
